description: Loki internals: requests, object storage, caches, distributor and ingester. See Loki 3.x Essential Metrics for the overview.

panels.title: Log messages
panels.description: Log lines Loki wrote about itself in the selected time range, all levels (loki_log_messages_total).

panels.title: Error log messages
panels.description: Error-level log lines Loki wrote about itself in the selected time range.

panels.title: Series stored
panels.description: Series written to the store in the selected time range (loki_store_series_total).

panels.title: Chunk bytes stored
panels.description: Chunk bytes the ingesters flushed to object storage in the selected time range.

panels.title: Panics
panels.description: Panics that Loki recovered from (loki_panic_total) in the selected time range. A panic that crashes a process restarts its container instead: see Restarts in Loki 3.x Essential Metrics.

panels.title: S3 request duration (p95)
panels.description: Requests from Loki to its S3 object storage, by operation.

panels.title: API request duration (p95)
panels.description: Loki's HTTP API routes only (push, OTLP, queries, labels, series, rules). Internal gRPC calls and the ready, metrics and build info endpoints are left out.

panels.title: LogQL latency (p95)
panels.description: LogQL query latency by query type.

panels.title: LogQL processed bytes / sec (p95)
panels.description: Bytes processed per second by LogQL queries, by query type.

panels.title: S3 requests / sec
panels.description: Requests from Loki to its S3 object storage, by operation and HTTP status code.

panels.title: Cache request duration (avg)
panels.description: Average duration of chunks and results cache (memcached) requests, by cache and method. Our Prometheus keeps only the _sum and _count of this histogram, so it is an average, not a percentile.

panels.title: Cache value size (avg)
panels.description: Average size of the values fetched from and stored in each cache. Our Prometheus keeps only the _sum and _count of this histogram, so it is an average, not a percentile.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Hits / fetched keys per cache. A cache with no lookups in the window shows no data.

panels.title: Background queue length
panels.description: Cache writes waiting in the background queue.

panels.title: Batch appends to ingesters / sec
panels.description: Appends sent from the distributors to the ingesters, and the ones that failed. The failure counter only exists after the first failure, so Failures shows 0 while the distributors report appends, and no data when they report nothing.

panels.title: Blocks per chunk (p95)
panels.description: Computed from chunk flushes, which are sporadic, so the panel's minimum interval is 10m.

panels.title: Chunk size (p95)
panels.description: Computed from chunk flushes, which are sporadic, so the panel's minimum interval is 10m.

panels.title: Chunk age at flush (p95)
panels.description: Computed from chunk flushes, which are sporadic, so the panel's minimum interval is 10m.

panels.title: Chunk compression ratio (p95)
panels.description: Uncompressed / compressed size of the flushed chunks. Computed from chunk flushes, which are sporadic, so the panel's minimum interval is 10m.

panels.title: Chunk encode time (p95)
panels.description: Computed from chunk flushes, which are sporadic, so the panel's minimum interval is 10m.

panels.title: Lines per chunk (p95)
panels.description: Computed from chunk flushes, which are sporadic, so the panel's minimum interval is 10m.

panels.title: Chunks created / flushed / stored per sec
